chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Buddy Bolden in the asylum and the Funky Butt song
summary: Joe thinks his father mended shoes for Buddy Bolden when he was in the Jackson asylum, and recalls the Funky Butt parody and tune confusions.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I've probably seen every one of these musicians at one time or another. I think that Buddy Bolden at one time was in my Dad's shoe-shop. Because Buddy Bolden died in the Jackson, Louisiana, insane asylum. I think he died in 1924.
'31, I thought.
Darensbourg - 154
Oh, whatever is...
I'm not dead sure;.
I know that they were fairly late years. You see? I know he was in a nut-house, but I don't know how he... It seemed to me my Dad did some shoe work for him; they would bring some of those patients.
Oh, when he was in the asylum.
Oh, yes.
I thought you meant way before.

Oh, yes. Because I don't... I never knew him, say, he'd played in Baton Rouge, really. Naturally, everybody used to talk about that little parody that came out, 'I Thought I Heard Buddy Bolden Say 'Funky Butt, Funky (?), Take It Away.'"
Where did that first come from? When did you first hear that?
I heard it when I was a kid. And 'funky' at that time means something dirty. It means you smelled bad. Said, 'Man, this guy is sure funky; why don't he go take a bath?'

People have said that was the song Buddy Bolden used to play, and Jelly said that he composed 'The Buddy Bolden Blues.' But 'The St. Louis Tickle' is the same thing; it's just faster; it's in 2/4 and faster. [SINGS
Darensbourg - 155
Did you ever hear that, "The St. Louis Tickle," a Ragtime piece?
Well, I've heard it.
So I don't know which came first. But the "St. Louis Tickle" was recorded on piano rolls years before Jelly came about the thing.
What is that somebody said, Kid Ory, "Muskrat Ramble" is "In The Mood" backwards?
Oh, Lord.
Yeah, I heard guys say that. They called it all of these crazy things.
